question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who is your favorite Wilson High student?

nodes.text: Sarah sneaks expertly through the room, dodging all of the cars, tools, and other things which make noise!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Nicely done! I guess I am pretty sneaky!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Now I just have to find a way to steal this float...
Sarah frantically rushes around, unhooking the chains...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Almost there...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Almost got it...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: There! Just one chain left...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Look. I admire your spirit. Really, I do.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: But I'm a gal of my word. And I promised Alexei I'd keep his float safe, so that's exactly what I'm gonna do!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: But... But... But... Don't you care about what's right?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Sorry, but I'm not really in the mood for a morality lecture from a girl who broke into my Auto-Shop and is trying to steal school property.
Suddenly, Sarah hears shouting from the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No! Not my car! Take me, take Sarah, just don't touch my car!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Gee, I don't know... What's a broken window or two?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Noooooo!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Uh oh. Sounds like your friend there needs some help!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Megan! I'm coming!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Now get outta here while the worst problem you've got is a broken window!
Well, that didn't go well at all! But that's only half the story!
Why don't you play as `Team Bacon Burger` and see if you can't get at least half the float out of Wilson's hands?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you play as [b]Team Bacon Burger[/b] and see if you can't get at least half the float out of Wilson's hands?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I know we've never met before... But I'm an honest person! Really! I am!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'm from Wilson! Why would I try to steal my own float?!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Alexei said they'd try all sorts of tricks... He said they might even recruit some people from Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I'm not buying it, sister. Get outta here!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Just use your head, would you?! Does Alexei really seem like the kind of guy who'd be able to build a float like this by himself?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: And don't you think it's weird that he built the whole thing but needs you guys to build the head?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Come on! I don't know you well, but you seem like you know what you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: How could you fall for Alexei's lies?! That guy's a creep, and everyone knows it!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Well... I gotta give you that. I've never liked that guy.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Then again... I don't like most jocks. Or rich kids. Or girls on the Spirit Council!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Look, this isn't about cliques or money. It's about doing the right thing!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I think I got it... One more chain...
Sarah steps back to look at the float...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What the...?! There's even more chains than when I started!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: This is impossible!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Almost there...
Suddenly, Sarah steps on a loose tire and slips! It goes flying across the room where it knocks over a huge box of wrenches!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Ooops!
Sarah sneaks into the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Nice and quiet... Just gotta find that float...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Hard to move... With all this junk... In the way...
Help Sarah get to the float without bumping into anything!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh? Then whose car is it?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well, see, it belongs to my friend Megan...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Megan... Megan... Why does that ring a bell?
Earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Now, Skazz, this next part is extremely important. It's very likely that the Centerscore Shop club is going to try to steal the float.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I've had some dealings with the Centerscore Auto-Shop, and let me tell you, they can be pretty devious.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I want you to keep an eye out for them... Especially a girl named Megan who drives a '68 Anaconda. You got that?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Megan. '68 Anaconda. Keep an eye out. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! You don't want to talk to me at all! You're working with the Centerscore kids!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! They're trying to break-
A steel-tipped boot comes flying from the bushes and nails Skazz in the back of the head!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Seeing... Stars... Sleepytime... Now...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Can't you do anything right?!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
There is a commotion from the far end of the parking lot! The other Wilson kids are coming!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'll hold them off as long as I can... You go get the float!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: ...Okay...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You own a '68 Anaconda, and you don't know much about cars?!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: It used to be my brother's, and he gave it to me as a gift...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: But I'm sure a guy like you could teach me all about it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uhhh... Sure!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Let's just... Get this hood open...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh... It seems to be sticking...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing to my car?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `Your car?` But the other girl said... And if she's lying... That means...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Your car?[/i][/color] But the other girl said... And if she's lying... That means...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Help! Help! It's the Centerscore punks! They're stealing the-
Sarah lunges forward and trips Skazz, pushing him headfirst into the car!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oooof!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What are you doing?! You're supposed to be stealing the float!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I never said you were allowed to let him touch my car! No one touches my car!
There is a commotion from the far end of the parking lot! The other Wilson kids are coming!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'll hold them off as long as I can... You go get the float!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: ...Okay...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You're not one of those loser Centerscore students, are you? The ones who might try to steal the float?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What? No, no, not at all. I go to Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: And I'm looking for a big, hunky guy... Do you know where I could find one?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uh, not really. I'm sort of busy guarding this Auto-Shop. I can't really chat right now.
Suddenly, Skazz's eyes light up as he notices Megan's car!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey... Is that a `1968 Anaconda?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey... Is that a [color=#e23b3b][i]1968 Anaconda?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What?! Where? I hate snakes!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, stupid, your car!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Yes. Yes, it is. I think. Maybe. Is it?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You don't know the model of your own car?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well, you see, the funny thing is...

nodes.prompt: You don't know the model of your own car?

options.label: I don't know much about cars.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You don't know the model of your own car?

nodes.text: A little while later... At Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: The Wilson High Auto-Shop is just past that guy... He must be the guard!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Go get ready to sneak in... I'll distract him!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well... Here goes...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well, hey there, cute guard guy.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh? Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Awesome! Let me see it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Hold on a sec... What did Stiletto tell me earlier?
Earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Now Skazz. Pay close attention because this is `extremely` important.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now Skazz. Pay close attention because this is [color=#3b78e2][i]extremely[/i][/color] important.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Those Centerscore kids are going to try everything they can to steal the float. That means getting past you.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: They'll probably try to lure you away by letting you check out the engine of a fancy car... Maybe even that Megan girl's '68 Anaconda.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Whatever you do, do `not` get distracted, no matter how exciting their distraction is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever you do, do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] get distracted, no matter how exciting their distraction is!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Did you remember?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Nope, not a clue. Let me see that engine!
Skazz pries open the hood and starts examining the engine. Across the lot, Sarah sneaks into the Auto-Shop, shooting Megan a big thumbs-up.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoops... Was that supposed to come off?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr... I'm gonna kill Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You gotta be out of your mind! Why would I possibly let you do that?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Jeez, you don't gotta yell at me! How am I supposed to help you get the tools you need if I can't look at your car?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Our Auto-Shop is way bigger than yours, you know!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey... Wait a minute...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Is that girl breaking in?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! Hey! Intruder! Intruder! They're breaking into our-
Megan lunges forward and headbutts Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oooof!
There is a commotion from the far end of the parking lot! The other Wilson kids are coming!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Run, Sarah! Get the float! We don't have much time!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm doing this...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey! You there!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh? Who the heck are...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Wait, I know you! You're one of those losers from Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Don't even think about trying to steal the float!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Float? What float? I'm just here to borrow some tools.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: My car's been giving me trouble... And the tools at Centerscore are way too broken down to help!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha! Man, I knew that place was weak...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What kind of car you drivin'?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh, you know. Just your average, everyday `1968 Anaconda.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you know. Just your average, everyday [color=#3b78e2][i]1968 Anaconda.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What?! You drive an Anaconda? For real? I've... I've always wanted to own an Anaconda...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Can I see the engine? Please let me see the engine! `I must see the engine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I see the engine? Please let me see the engine! [color=#e23b3b][i]I must see the engine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ugh... This loser? Touching my baby? Arggggh!
A little while later... At Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: The Wilson High Auto-Shop is just past that guy!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: He must be the guard!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'll go sneak around the back... You go distract him!
Can Megan pull it off? Play as her and find out!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I mean, Kenji said the float was being guarded by the Wilson High Auto-Shop club, right?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I wouldn't even know where to begin dealing with them!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense. Sort of.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr... I hate those Wilson kids! I can't believe I'm going to have to put up with them!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I knew Kenji was lying when he said all I'd have to do is drive!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: You're... Uh... Gripping the wheel pretty tight...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What?! Seriously? You want me to risk getting caught breaking into Wilson High just for some stupid float?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well... I'm not exactly stealthy, okay? I don't know if you noticed, but I'm pretty loud.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Besides, I bet I can distract their guards with my feminine wiles!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So, what are you implying? That I don't have feminine wiles?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What? No! That's not... I didn't...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Okay, I'll admit that came out all wrong. Your wiles are very, very feminine.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I just think you're more suited to breaking and entering than I am! I don't even know what the 'breaking' part refers to!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ugh, whatever. Let's just get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I don't know if you've thought this through, but I can't exactly distract the guards `and` steal the float at the same time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if you've thought this through, but I can't exactly distract the guards [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] steal the float at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Back to silence, huh?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This isn't silence. It's seething rage.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: ...Oh. Does that mean you'll help me?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ugh. Fine. What else do you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I think you should...

options.label: Sneak in and steal the float!

nodes.text: Howard turns and hurries off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just when I think I know that guy... He manages to surprise me!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey... You ready to do this?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, I am.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Then let's get going. Sarah and Megan are already on their way.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Do you think they'll be able to pull it off?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. What's the worst thing that could happen?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, if we get caught, it could be really bad...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And this isn't really your fight. I mean, you thought school spirit was lame, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I didn't know better, I'd think that was a burn...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the fact that you're trying to protect me is just so adorable, I'll let it slide.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, ha ha. Real funny.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously though, I get it. You don't have to sugarcoat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've done enough capers in my day to know that you never wanna throw a new guy in at the last minute.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... You have?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When this is all over, I'll tell you about them, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And remember... If you need my help... Just give me a call.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The plan? What plan? I thought you were in charge of this...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually... It's Kenji's plan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kenji? You mean, Kenji from the Auto-Shop? This whole thing was `his` idea?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kenji? You mean, Kenji from the Auto-Shop? This whole thing was [color=#e23b3b][i]his[/i][/color] idea?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kind of...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then... I guess, uh, the two of you have been spending some time together...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, yeah... He `did` help me build the float.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, yeah... He [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] help me build the float.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh.
Howard looks down, crestfallen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I'm going to get out of here... You and Kenji have fun, okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait, Howard, I...
When we last left off...
Kenji and Linda assembled the perfect team to try to steal back the Centerscore float!
But will they be able to pull it off? And will their float win the `$10,000` prize?
nodes.text_bbcode: But will they be able to pull it off? And will their float win the [b]$10,000[/b] prize?

nodes.text: Play on and find out!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We don't have much time, so I'm only going to be able to lay out the plan once.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sarah, Megan... You are `Team Roast Beef.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sarah, Megan... You are [color=#e23b3b][i]Team Roast Beef.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Your mission is to steal back the main body of our float. Right now, it's in the Wilson High Auto-Shop where it's being fitted with a badger head.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It's not going to be easy. The float is being guarded by their toughest and most unflinching Auto-Shop students... including their leader, Stiletto.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Trust me... You don't want to mess with Stiletto!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: How are we supposed to get past them?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's for you to figure out.
Kenji turns to Linda, Mona, and Spud.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now, the head of our lizard float is being kept in a backpack worn by Alexei, the President of the Wilson High Spirit Council.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's where we come in. `Team Bacon Burger.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's where we come in. [color=#e23b3b][i]Team Bacon Burger.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Alexei's throwing a huge party tonight, and his house is wired with a state-of-the-art security system.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spud, your job is to hack it, giving me, Linda, and Mona enough time to sneak in.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Once we're inside, Mona will charm Alexei into following her somewhere private...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Where we'll ambush him, take back the lizard head, and escape!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh, I've got one.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What's with the team names?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: ...I was hungry when I wrote up the mission plan.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We've got fifteen minutes until go-time. Everyone go take a breather... And then let's get `Operation Chicken Fajita` on the road!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got fifteen minutes until go-time. Everyone go take a breather... And then let's get [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation Chicken Fajita[/i][/color] on the road!

nodes.text: Linda steps out into the parking lot for some fresh air...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Uh, Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You got a minute?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, um, hi. Yeah, I guess I do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I just wanted to apologize for how I acted the other day. The way I blew you off when you needed my help...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was very not cool, okay? And I'm sorry. I don't really know what I was thinking, but I know I wasn't a good friend.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, it's... It's okay. We all do dumb things sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are we cool?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, we're cool.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, look... If you do need any help with the float now...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... We've had some complications...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Complications? What kind of complications?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's kind of a long story...
Thirty seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're planning to steal back the float?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know, I know, it sounds crazy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Crazy? It sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I really think it... Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Pulling off a caper `and` sticking it to Wilson? Count me in!
nodes.text_bbcode: Pulling off a caper [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] sticking it to Wilson? Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now Howard wants to help... But it's too late to change the plan!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, I... I really appreciate it... But I think you ought to sit this one out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? Why?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well...

options.label: I don't want you to get in trouble.
You're not part of the plan.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: And... Just snip that wire there... Reroute that cable there...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Voila! Security system disabled!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now to send them the code signal...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: HOOOOOTEY HOO! HOOOOTEY HOO!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I sure know how to throw a party, huh? Not many people could draw a crowd this big!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I guess it's just what happens when you're this cool...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yep! I bet it is! But why don't we go somewhere a little more... Private?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You know, you haven't truly lived until you've been to the Make-out Capital of the Western Hemisphere...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Cincinnati?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: No! My room! You want a tour?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: S... Sure!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji better know what he's doing... Because I won't be able to take this sleazebag for much longer!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe I'm familiar... Cuz you've been dreaming about me your whole life!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You know what, hot stuff? You might just be right...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Let's find out!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Nothing! Nothing at all!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Man... For a minute... I swear I heard this loser I know from Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You, uh, must be hearing things! This place is really crowded!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure you don't know me... I must just have one of those plain, generic faces, I guess!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You've got a beautiful face! You're like Ellen of Troy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's quite right...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Baby, you're stunning! You're an angel! You could be a model, or like, one of those girls who stands around in a bikini at drag races!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow... He's really falling for it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So this is your place, isn't it? It's really packed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see here...
A few minutes later...
Linda is wearing a pink wig, black lipstick, and a ragged 'Blahmones' T-shirt!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ta-dah! What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It's okay, but... Are you sure that's Alexei's type?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You don't think so?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, it...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh no! It's Alexei! He's coming this way!
Kenji dives behind a nearby couch, and just in time!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, you! Do I know you? You sure don't look like someone I'd invite to my party...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, uh, no! No, you don't know me... I'm here with... Uh... Bob.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Bob, huh? I don't know any Bobs... But I think I'd like to know you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, hee hee, that's pretty forward!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What can I say? Punk chicks might not be my usual thing... But you're pretty cute! And... Kind of familiar...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can't believe it... But I think this is working! How should I play this?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, no, I'm sure you don't know me... I don't really run in your kind of circles...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean? You saying I'm sleazy?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, no! Not at all!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You're at my party. You're eating my snacks. You're talking to me. I think that means you run in my circles!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, no! I didn't mean anything bad! I just meant... Um... When I go running... It's not in circles... Around you?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You're a pretty weird girl.
A long awkward moment passes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... It's really packed here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, you don't know me... But I bet you'd like to!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yowza! I like a girl who's straightforward!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Did you just hear something?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sure it was nothing, cutie... I don't know how you can even hear anything in a place this packed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see here...
A few minutes later...
Linda is wearing a baseball cap, tanktop, and big sunglasses!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And here I am! Do I look good?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh yeah! I bet that's just Alexei's type!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not yours, though?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nope, I like you just the way you are!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Speaking of Alexei... He's coming our way!
Kenji dives into the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Well, hello, hello. Who might you be?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, you know. Just your average sporty girl, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: From where I'm standing, hottie, there ain't nothing average about you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Is that what you think?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Heck yeah, that's what I think! You're stunning! And... A little familiar? Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He's really falling for it! How should I play this?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This is not good.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do we do now? How are we going to lure Alexei away?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Let me think... Let me think...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, look! Mona dropped her bag!
Linda opens Mona's bag... And finds it full of wigs, hats, and other costume parts!
Kenji takes the bag and starts going through it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Getting an idea... Getting an idea...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Who says Mona has to be the decoy? `You` can do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who says Mona has to be the decoy? [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] can do it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, look, Kenji, I'm not an actress or anything... I mean, maybe we should just call it off...
Kenji steps forward and takes Linda's hand.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda, we've come this far together... Against all odds, we got together the perfect team and infiltrated an impenetrable party...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You really gonna give up on me now?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha! Are you kidding? Gimme that bag!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear! Now let's see... What disguise should you wear?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Forget the plan! I couldn't care less about the plan!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What plan? What are you guys even doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Is this some kind of setup?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...Uh... Sort of?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're making things worse!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I knew it! I knew I couldn't hook up with a Wilson girl without Centerscore finding out!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh, you treacherous cretin! How long has this been going on? How long were you deceiving me?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Ugh, this is ridiculous! I should've listened when they told me Centerscore guys were losers!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Porscha! Come back!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going, you slimy toad?!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Get back here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mona... Wait... What about...
Mona rushes off, vanishing into the crowd in a screeching and overly articulate blur.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: The... The show... Must... Go on?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: The show must go on.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well, I must tell you, Hector, you've made a stunning choice! I wish you the very best!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Have a most lovely evening, darling! I do hope you've warned your new paramour about your `back zits` problem!
nodes.text_bbcode: Have a most lovely evening, darling! I do hope you've warned your new paramour about your [color=#3b78e2][i]back zits[/i][/color] problem!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Back zits? Ewwww! I'm out of here! Centerscore guys really are losers!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Porscha! Come back!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mona... That was... A pretty good save!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: We're not out of the woods yet!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: What's going on over here? Alexei doesn't want any trouble!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh, just a little romantic row! You know how it goes, don't you, darling?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: No. No, I don't.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'm going to have to ask you to leave! Alexei's given me the authority to boot troublemakers... And you've got trouble written all over you!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well... If there's no other choice... I shall depart. But know that I am completely alone in my outrage and not part of any larger plan!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Let's get going.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Farewell, one and all! Adieu! Adieu!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait! Mona! We need you to...
It's too late. Steve drags Mona to the front door and shoves her out! She waves sadly.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Argh... I can't take the pressure! Half of twenty-two is... twelve?
Spud cuts the wire... And sets off an alarm down the street!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oops! I didn't realize the whole neighborhood was wired together!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now's your chance, `Team Bacon Burger!` Sorry this wasn't more subtle!!!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now's your chance, [color=#e23b3b][i]Team Bacon Burger![/i][/color] Sorry this wasn't more subtle!!!

nodes.text: Outside Alexei's house...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow! That's one huge party he's throwing! Look at all those people!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All the better for us... We'll blend right in!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I don't mean to ruin your plan, darling, but it looks like they've got some guys checking student IDs at the door... And they're not letting anyone uninvited in!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's why we're diving in through the back window!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spud... It looks like Alexei's got three security cameras pointed at the window at all times. Can you disable them?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmm... Those look like the CastleKeep Model 900s... Piece of cake! I can crack those in my sleep!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'll have to get in close to find the switchbox, but I should be able to give you a nice ten minutes without any security!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ten minutes? What about when we need to escape?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmm... If you can make it to the front door... I might be able to raise a false alarm in the back that'll distract everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spud... You're the man. Make us proud!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Spud darts off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We wait... And we hope Spud knows what he's doing!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let's see... the switchbox should be right around here!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Aha!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Looks like a math-encoded protocol... Easy enough... Just gonna have to switch all the settings to half...
Help Spud hack the switchbox by dividing the numbers in half!
Linda sprints with the grace of a cheetah, leaping down alleys and over fences, easily keeping up with Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did we make it?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aaaah!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I've got my people surrounding you on all sides. Now give over the lizard head or face the consequences!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We... We got so close...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Close only counts in horseshoes and hand grenades... And we ain't playing neither!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I've always wanted to say that...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You won't get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, blah, blah. Give me the lizard head already!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Run... Faster...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... Can't! I can't go on...
Kenji grabs Linda's hand.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Just a little... Farther...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You hear that commotion? That's our cue to bail!
While everyone else is distracted, Linda and Kenji sneak out of the party!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Not yet you didn't!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh no! He's awake! `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! He's awake! [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Get them!!!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: So? Don't you remember when I faced the Nine-Headed Walrus Warrior of the Western Wastelands?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: He was stronger than you...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But you defeated him through your courage and valor!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: Exactly! Do you understand, Sir Spud?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes, Ogg'thokk! I do! Thank you! I'll never forget this!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: Of course, Sir Spud! Fight with honor! And get some more sunlight while you're at it!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You okay, there? You're talking to yourself...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: RAAAAAAAAAAWR!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: EEEEEEEK!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Take that, you nine-headed bully!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now let's set off this distraction!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: You don't? Not even a little?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: Not even with, like, a battle-axe?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: How about a trident?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I've never even seen one in real life!
Meanwhile... Back in reality...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: He's just been lying there mumbling to himself?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Yeah... I don't know what's wrong with him. He keeps calling me 'Ogg'thokk'!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `YO! ALEXEI! WE'VE GOT SOME KIND OF CRAZY INTRUDER!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YO! ALEXEI! WE'VE GOT SOME KIND OF CRAZY INTRUDER![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: ALEXEI!!!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So this is your bedroom? It's, um, nice. I like all the trophies...
Yeah, well, I like to win...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: But I really don't like to lose!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh... Ha ha... That's... Pretty funny...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Now then... About that making out...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The only thing you'll be making out with...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: `Is my fist!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is my fist![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: GAAAAAH!
WHAM!
Kenji knocks Alexei out cold!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: ...And `that` was pretty much the coolest thing I've ever done.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was pretty much the coolest thing I've ever done.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And I couldn't have done it without you!
And suddenly, Kenji steps forward and kisses Linda!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know what to think!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Is everything okay? I mean, I hope that was all right...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... I mean, yes... I mean... I'm not sure!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We can talk about it later.
Kenji rips open Alexei's backpack and pulls out a pristine mechanical lizard head!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now let's get you out of that disguise and get us the heck out of here!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: That's a text from Linda! It must be time for me to set off the decoy alarms!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let's see here... Just gotta cut this wire...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Aaaaahhh!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing, you little dweeb?!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Aaaaaaah! Run!
Spud makes it three feet before slipping and falling on his head!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: ...Huh? Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: You are in the magical land of Azterploth!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You... You... You're...

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: Yes, Sir Spud! Tis I, your greatest hero, `Ogg'thokk Warkitten!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, Sir Spud! Tis I, your greatest hero, [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogg'thokk Warkitten![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Am I dreaming?

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: In all likelihood, yes. But that's not the point!

nodes.speaker: Ogg'thokk
nodes.text: The real question is, why are you running away from a righteous fight? Have you no honor? Have you no valor?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But... But Ogg'thokk...

options.label: I don't know how to fight!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I tried to help you out, I really did...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: But I can't be blamed if Wilson is better in every way! This just proves it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm outta here too.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're not gonna help?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Look, I helped you build it once, `and` I tried to help you steal it back! At a certain point, you've just got to admit it's not meant to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I helped you build it once, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] I tried to help you steal it back! At a certain point, you've just got to admit it's not meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Peace! Have a good life, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...What do I do now?
The next day... At the town parade!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: And now, it's time for the annual float contest!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: First up, we have the Centerscore School float... And it truly is a nightmare! A ghastly mishmash of disjointed parts! One of the worst I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: To even call this travesty a float is to insult not only floats, but parades, small towns, and the spirit of America itself!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That... That bad?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Yes, Linda. That bad.

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Next up is Wilson High! Their float is truly majestic, a massive and elegant mechanical badger with an exotic reptilian body!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: His form represents raw power, and the black cube he is perched on is truly an amazing final touch!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: I don't even need to see the rest! Wilson wins! `WILSON WINS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even need to see the rest! Wilson wins! [color=#e23b3b][i]WILSON WINS![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, you'd better believe it. You made all of us look like idiots! I'm officially kicking you out of the Spirit Council!
Ms. Prez storms off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Argh! I wish I'd never gotten involved in any of this! School spirit is dead, and everyone's a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm never getting involved in anything ever again!
Wow... You know you've played badly when your game ends in a vow of solitude!
Play one more time, for poor Linda's sake, and give her the happy ending she deserves!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Shhh now! The mayor's talking!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: And the winner of the `$10,000` grand prize is...
nodes.text_bbcode: And the winner of the [color=#e23b3b][i]$10,000[/i][/color] grand prize is...

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: How can that be?! Our float wasn't great, but it had to be better than theirs, right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Didn't you know? A bunch of thugs broke into the Wilson High Auto-Shop last night and stole their float! Those poor Wilson kids had to put one together this morning!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: The judges all just felt so bad for them! I'm sure that's why the won!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wilson won... Because we stole our float back? That's so unfair!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I bet if we'd gotten both halves of the float, this wouldn't have happened!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You think it's my fault?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No, no... I just think we could have made some better choices, you know?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... We really could have!
To come so close and still lose the prize? That's got to sting something fierce!
Why don't you try one more time and see if you can't prove that Centerscore Spirit wins in the end?

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: Later that night, everyone regroups in the Centerscore Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We totally failed, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess so... Maybe we'll be able to throw together a float really quickly? I bet we can use that old hubcap... And there's a little leftover paint...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but I'm gonna get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're leaving?
The next day... At the town parade!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do you think, Ms. Prez? Is our float okay?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, it's not bad... But to be honest, I expected more from you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: It just feels incomplete... Disjointed... Like you rushed half of it this morning!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...I guess...
You played a solid game... But don't you feel like there are some loose ends still hanging?
Why don't you play again and see if you can't get that perfect score... And the bonus scene that comes with it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We did it! We really did it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Don't you just love it when a plan comes together?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks to you!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Way to go, man. You really saved our butts.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's just how I roll.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Well, we appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll always be there for you, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh... Um... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, I could've gotten her out of that mess. We didn't `need` your help.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I could've gotten her out of that mess. We didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] your help.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Because it sure looked like you managed to get her `into` that mess...
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Because it sure looked like you managed to get her [color=#e23b3b][i]into[/i][/color] that mess...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guys! Guys!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Can we cut out the macho headbutting and just be happy that we pulled this off?
There is a long, tense moment...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Fine.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: ...Fine.
Howard drives Linda and Kenji to the Auto-Shop, where Sarah is waiting for them!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: We got the body, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And we got the head... And gave Alexei something to think about next time he tries another stunt like that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thank you so much for helping us, Sarah. We wouldn't have been able to do it without you!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Just doing the right thing... It was my pleasure!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You're not forgetting us, are you darling?
Linda turns to the other side of the room, where Mona, Megan, and Spud are all waiting.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guys... I just can't thank you enough, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Without you, none of this would have been possible!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, darling! It was the role of a lifetime!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: All right, I'll admit it... That was kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now let's put this float together!
The next day... At the town parade!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: And the winner of the `$10,000` grand prize for best float is...
nodes.text_bbcode: And the winner of the [color=#e23b3b][i]$10,000[/i][/color] grand prize for best float is...

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You did it, Linda! You won the prize! I'm so proud of you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Prez... But it wasn't just me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I had help... From the shop kids... From the nerds... From the drama club... Even from a girl at Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If it weren't for all of them, none of this would be possible!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I guess school spirit is alive and well, huh? Who knew?
The crowd cheers as Linda steps up to accept the prize.
In the front row, Howard waves and smiles... And Kenji stands right next to him, grinning and throwing a thumbs-up!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I pulled off the greatest caper in Centerscore history...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now if only I knew what to do about these two guys!
Congratulations! You beat the Wilson kids, won the prize, and proved that school spirit is real! Talk about a great day!
But what about Howard and Kenji? Which one will Linda pick?
That's a story for another episode of 'Surviving High School'!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's our cue! Run for it! Dive through the window!
A few minutes later... In Alexei's house...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huff!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yay! We made it in!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now, Mona... you remember the plan, right?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Of course, darling! I find this Alexei, win him over with my charms, and... Gasp!
Mona stares across the room in utter shock.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: ...Mona?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: That's... That's my ex-boyfriend Hector! We broke up just a week ago...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: And he's here making out with some other girl! That... That swine!
Before Linda can stop her, Mona tears across the party to a couch at the far corner!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: M... Mona? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh, how nice! You detached yourself from the blonde barracuda over there to actually talk to me! What a true gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mona! Calm down! You're making a scene!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hector, do you know this loser?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Loser?! I'll show you who the real loser is, you mewling, impudent milkmaid!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not sure what you're talking about, but don't talk to her that way!
All around the room, people start turning and staring! The fight is drawing a lot of attention!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda! You have to calm her down!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mona!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.prompt: You have to calm her down!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You have to calm her down!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Later that night, everyone regroups in the Centerscore Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We didn't get the head... But at least we got the body.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guess we'll just have to throw something together in the next couple of hours.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, think of it this way... At least I got to punch Alexei, right?
Megan and Sarah drive towards Wilson High in silence.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: So... You don't talk much, do you?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What's there to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I don't know... The plan? How we're going to do this? Who's going to do what?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Uh, seems pretty clear to me. I'm doing the driving. You're doing everything else.
Sarah bursts into the Auto-Shop...
Where the float is tied down with dozens of heavy chains!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: How am I supposed to get all of these off?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hurry, Sarah! I can't hold them back much longer!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Aaah!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Man, Alexei was right after all. You Centerscore losers did come to steal our float!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: First of all, I go to Wilson, not Centerscore, you inobservant jerk! I'm on the darn Spirit Council!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: And secondly, it's not `your` float! It was built by a girl at Centerscore!
nodes.text_bbcode: And secondly, it's not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] float! It was built by a girl at Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Alexei built this float!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Yeah? Did you see him build it? Did you help him out?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Why... Why should I believe you?
Later that night, everyone regroups in the Centerscore Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We got the head... But not the body?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess not... We're just going to have to throw something together in the next couple of hours!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: At least we got to stick it to Alexei, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I guess.
A little while later... At Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: The Wilson High Auto-Shop is just past that guy... He must be the guard!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Go get ready to sneak in... I'll distract him!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well... Here goes...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well, hey there, cute guard guy.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh? Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You're not one of those loser Centerscore students, are you? The ones who might try to steal the float?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What? No, no, not at all. I go to Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: And I'm looking for a big, hunky guy... Do you know where I could find one?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uh, not really. I'm sort of busy guarding this Auto-Shop. I can't really chat right now.
Suddenly, Skazz's eyes light up as he notices Megan's car!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey... Is that a `1968 Anaconda?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey... Is that a [color=#e23b3b][i]1968 Anaconda?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What?! Where? I hate snakes!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, stupid, your car!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Yes. Yes, it is. I think. Maybe. Is it?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You don't know the model of your own car?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well, you see, the funny thing is...

nodes.prompt: You don't know the model of your own car?

options.label: I don't know much about cars.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You don't know the model of your own car?

nodes.text: Outside Alexei's house...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow! That's one huge party he's throwing! Look at all those people!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All the better for us... We'll blend right in!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I don't mean to ruin your plan, darling, but it looks like they've got some guys checking student IDs at the door... And they're not letting anyone uninvited in!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's why we're diving in through the back window!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spud... It looks like Alexei's got three security cameras pointed at the window at all times. Can you disable them?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmm... Those look like the CastleKeep Model 900s... Piece of cake! I can crack those in my sleep!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'll have to get in close to find the switchbox, but I should be able to give you a nice ten minutes without any security!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ten minutes? What about when we need to escape?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmm... If you can make it to the front door... I might be able to raise a false alarm in the back that'll distract everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spud... You're the man. Make us proud!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Spud darts off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We wait... And we hope Spud knows what he's doing!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let's see... the switchbox should be right around here!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Aha!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Looks like a math-encoded protocol... Easy enough... Just gonna have to switch all the settings to half...
Help Spud hack the switchbox by dividing the numbers in half!
Later that night, everyone regroups in the Centerscore Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We didn't get the head... But at least we got the body.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guess we'll just have to throw something together in the next couple of hours.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, think of it this way... At least I got to punch Alexei, right?
Later that night, everyone regroups in the Centerscore Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We totally failed, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess so... Maybe we'll be able to throw together a float really quickly? I bet we can use that old hubcap... And there's a little leftover paint...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but I'm gonna get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're leaving?

nodes.text: Stiletto thinks long and hard for a minute...
Then bends down and frees the float!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: The float's yours. You've got two minutes. Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What... I... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: You're going to have to hurry. I can't look weak in front of my people. You understand.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Actually... I don't... But thanks anyway!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Don't thank me. I'm just doing the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: And if you ever break into the Auto-Shop again, I'll knock your stupid teeth in!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind!
Congratulations! You got the float!
But the float's no good without its head! Let's check in with `Team Bacon Burger` and see how they're doing!
nodes.text_bbcode: But the float's no good without its head! Let's check in with [b]Team Bacon Burger[/b] and see how they're doing!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Going somewhere in a hurry?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aaaah!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Now hand over the lizard, or I'll... Huh?
Suddenly, a car screeches up next to Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Quick! Get in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: H... Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew you'd need my help! Now jump in!
Linda and Kenji dive into the car, and they speed off into the night!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What?! No!!!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: This isn't happening! `This can't be happening!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't happening! [color=#e23b3b][i]This can't be happening![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Is there anything more satisfying than pulling off a perfect caper? You bet... And that's playing a perfect game!
Enjoy your bonus scene, you brilliant, brilliant player, and find out how some other students are dealing with the Float Caper Fallout!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So how about that prize money, huh? Are we going to get to host our $10,000 dance?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Actually, since you didn't help on the float at all, neither of you gets any say in how it is spent!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: But don't worry! The Centerscore School Board has decided to spend $1,000 on a new soccer field...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And the rest on a new Teachers' Lounge!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you joking?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm feeling lightheaded...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's how I usually feel!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up, you idiot!
Meanwhile... At Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Please, Darren, Steve! You can't abandon me!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry, Alexei. We report to the President of the Spirit Council...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: And that's not you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: That's right, Alexei....

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: There's a new sheriff in town!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Nooooooooo!
Congratulations on a perfect ending to 'The Great Float Caper!' Be sure to get the next episode for even more 'Surviving High School!'
